The implementation follows the installed Next.js guide and updates React and React DOM to 19.3.1, which provides `ViewTransition`. See [ProductGrid.tsx](/workspace/app/ProductGrid.tsx), [PageTransition.tsx](/workspace/app/PageTransition.tsx), and [globals.css](/workspace/app/globals.css).
